properties.name: Árpádváros
properties.sourceScopeNote: The complete separate source cell named Árpádváros on Figure73, with the parking-street perimeter described on PDF147.
properties.method: Every boundary vertex is an original maxRGB<=45 black pixel on the exact embedded municipal Figure73 JPEG. Dense rings follow only 8-neighbor source-pixel paths guided by manually inspected stroke corridors. A literal black connected-component subset excludes detached photographic specks; no pixel is added, no missing edge is filled and no image-frame closure, buffer, snap, simplification or repair is used. The complete original apartment-back parking zigzag is retained instead of replacing it by an unresolved modern road-node chain. Six approximate historical source-junction observations fit an affine transform to literal current OSM nodes in EPSG:23700. Four old observations are transferred through the exact PDF page-image placement on the same byte-identical Figure73 image; two southern observations are new. A failed earlier same-image Jókai/Piaristák candidate is preserved outside the fit. Exact historical-to-current physical point identity has not been independently validated, so all geographic output remains inferred.

properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; original orthoimage capture date unknown.

sourceRaster.pixelCoordinateConvention: Integer source-image pixel indices; x right/y down; no half-pixel offset.

properties.attribution: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó Vizsgálat II., May2021 consultation draft, Figure73; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
reviewNotes: The full historical black source contour supplies the shared parking corridor, independently of unresolved modern road-graph interpretation.
Only actual source black pixels occur on the ring. There is no label-occlusion inference, invented connecting segment or image-frame closure.
The excluded older same-image point is retained as a failed diagnostic, not hidden or accepted as a registration validation.
Current exact physical control identities, current/legal boundary extent, absolute accuracy and address assignment are unverified.
